entries.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
entries.summary: Introducing GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol, with better professional outputs, coding, computer use, and efficiency at lower cost across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API.
entries.why: Delivers improved professional outputs, coding, and computer use at a lower cost across multiple interfaces.

entries.title: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
entries.summary: OpenAI models optimized circuits used in Jalapeño silicon and improved RISC‑V core designs, showing progress in AI-assisted chip design with GPT‑6 Astra.
entries.why: Demonstrates practical AI-assisted chip design by optimizing circuits for Jalapeño silicon and RISC-V cores.

entries.title: TeleChat to Xing4: Advancing Frontier Agentic Models on Domestic Chips and Frameworks
entries.summary: We present Xing 4, a series of large language models that extends the TeleChat lineage through coordinated advances in model architecture and training infrastructure on Ascend.
entries.why: Advances frontier agentic models through coordinated architectural and infrastructural updates on Ascend hardware.

entries.title: A 4.5M-parameter TTS model runs 70x real-time on CPU and cost just $10 to train
entries.why: Provides an extremely efficient text-to-speech option running fast on CPUs with minimal training overhead.

entries.title: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs
entries.summary: Kernel optimization is essential for efficient large language model (LLM) training and inference on Ascend NPUs.
entries.why: Establishes a cost-aware kernel optimization benchmark for real-world workloads on Ascend NPUs.

entries.title: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
entries.summary: Standard neural architectures such as the Transformer were chosen because they train well with gradient descent and run fast on GPUs.
entries.why: Explores alternative neural architectures showing that weight-space programming does not require Transformers.

entries.title: Self-Improvement Memory Enables Continual Recursive Self-Improvement
entries.summary: Harness optimization is often studied with a fixed policy model and benchmark. When either changes, the optimizer must decide which parts of an evolved harness to reuse or revise, but the harness alone may not explain why earlier edits were made or how they performed.
entries.why: Addresses how self-improvement memory enables continual recursive self-improvement without losing track of past edits.

entries.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
entries.why: Expands open-weight model availability with image-text-to-text capabilities under the Qwen lineage.

entries.title: internlm/Sage-S2.1-Flash · Hugging Face
entries.summary: Introduction Sage S2.1 Flash is a scientific multimodal model from Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory designed for research tasks that require multiple rounds of analysis and verification.
entries.why: Offers a scientific multimodal model designed for research tasks requiring multiple rounds of analysis.

entries.title: Lightricks/LTX-2.5
entries.why: Provides a robust diffusion-based single-file image-to-video model with extensive community downloads.

entries.title: Advancing computer-use agents for healthcare teams
entries.why: Extends practical computer-use agent capabilities tailored specifically for healthcare team workflows.

entries.title: Anthropic institute agenda
entries.why: Outlines new strategic research priorities and agenda directions from the Anthropic institute.

entries.title: Quickly, There’s No Time
entries.summary: In response to the METR report, many people have been reevaluating their timelines.
entries.why: Reevaluates development timelines and industry pacing in response to recent findings from the METR report.

entries.title: Running the full server-side Datasette Python app in the browser with service workers and Pyodide
entries.summary: Datasette Lite is my port of the Datasette Python application to run directly in the browser using WebAssembly and Pyodide. I've released a complete rewrite of Datasette Lite using service workers, and it's now almost indistinguishable from the real server-side application.…
entries.why: Brings the full server-side Datasette Python app into the browser using service workers and Pyodide.

entries.title: Understanding Positional Embeddings in Modern LLMs
entries.summary: The Methods Behind How LLMs Represent Token Positions
entries.why: Breaks down the underlying methods and mechanics of how modern LLMs represent token positions.
